help.title: ⟦kpe⟧ Help ··
help.saving.title: ⟦kpe⟧ How saving works ·····
help.saving.body: ⟦kpe⟧ Every answer is saved on your phone as you type. When you tap “Save form”, the form waits in line to be sent. You never need network to save. ··········································
help.offline.title: ⟦kpe⟧ What happens when there is no network? ···········
help.offline.body: ⟦kpe⟧ Keep working. Saved forms wait safely on the phone, locked with your password. When network comes back, FieldSync sends them by itself — on most Android phones even if the app is closed. ························································
help.colours.title: ⟦kpe⟧ What the labels mean ······
help.colours.body: ⟦kpe⟧ Waiting: saved, not sent yet. Sending: going to the server now. Will retry: the network failed, FieldSync will try again by itself. Sent: the server has it. Needs fixing or Changed on server: open the form and follow the steps. ····································································
help.problems.title: ⟦kpe⟧ If a form needs attention ········
help.problems.body: ⟦kpe⟧ “Needs fixing” means the server could not accept an answer: open it, correct it, send again. “Changed on server” means your supervisor changed it: choose which version to keep. ·····················································
help.lost.title: ⟦kpe⟧ If your phone is lost or stolen ·········
help.lost.body: ⟦kpe⟧ Tell your supervisor at once. They will remove the phone from FieldSync. Your saved forms are encrypted, so nobody can read them without your password. ·············································
help.shared.title: ⟦kpe⟧ Sharing a phone ·····
help.shared.body: ⟦kpe⟧ Each person signs in with their own account, and each account’s forms are locked separately. Use “Switch user” in Settings. Never share passwords. ············································
help.support: ⟦kpe⟧ When something goes wrong, FieldSync shows a support code like FS-1A2B3C. Read it to your supervisor. ······························
help.install.title: ⟦kpe⟧ Install FieldSync ·····
help.install.body: ⟦kpe⟧ Open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”. Installed, FieldSync opens like an app and the phone protects its saved forms. ·············································
